contentPattern.structure: grid of white bordered link tiles, each a blue left-accent bar + a single linked heading (no image, no description)

suitableFor: section / menu landing page navigation tile grids (linked heading only)
bordered white link-card grids with a colored left-accent bar
'choose a section' link lists rendered as equal bordered tiles
notSuitableFor: solid blue icon-link tiles with a circular icon (use cards-tiles)
bordered cards with a centered logo + description (use cards-awards)
photo teaser cards with an image + category + heading (use cards-topic)
KPI statistic cards with a figure + label (use cards-stats)
filterable article grids with a topic select + Load more (use cards-articles)
